questions.question: Which of the following folk dance is performed mainly in Chhattisgarh?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Raut.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raut is a traditional folk dance form of Chhattisgarh, which is performed by the Yadav community during the Holi festival.**
 
• The dance is mainly performed by men, who wear colorful costumes and play musical instruments like dhol, nagada, and tasa.
 
• **The dancers move in a circular formation, and the dance involves a lot of jumping, spinning, and clapping.**
 
• **Raut is believed to have originated from the mythological story of Lord Krishna and the gopis, who used to dance in a similar way during the Holi festival.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kalbelia** is a folk dance form of **Rajasthan**, which is performed by the **Kalbelia tribe**.

 
 
• **The dance is known for its graceful movements and snake-like arm and hand gestures.**
 
 
 
• **Bhangra **is a folk dance form of **Punjab**, which is performed by both **men and women**.
 
 
• The dance involves high-energy movements and is accompanied by **dhol** and other traditional musical instruments.
 
 
 
• **Roudra is not a folk dance form, but it is a Sanskrit word which means "angry" or "fierce".**

• The dance form gets its name from the Hindu God Vishnu.
 
• In Hindu mythology, **Mohini is a female avatar of Lord Vishnu.**
 
• Mohiniyattam reflects the theme of love and devotion, **where the dancer often plays the role of Mohini, who is the amorous and devoted heroine.**
 
• **Mohini, the divine enchantress, is often depicted as seductive, beautiful, and capable of mesmerizing those who she wishes to influence.**
 
• The dance form is characterized by graceful and gentle movements, **and it is traditionally performed solo by women.**

questions.question: Indian Classical Dance is an umbrella under which various performing arts whose theory and practice can be traced to the Sanskrit text, Natya-Shastra, the foundational treatise by:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharata Muni**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharata Muni** is the author of the Natya-Shastra, the foundational treatise on Indian classical dance and performing arts.
 
• The Natya-Shastra is a comprehensive text that covers various aspects of performing arts, including dance, music, and theater.
 
• It is considered one of the oldest and most authoritative texts on classical Indian dance and drama.
 
• The treatise lays down the principles and techniques that form the basis of various Indian classical dance forms such as Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Odissi, and others.
 
• Bharata Muni's work has had a profound influence on the development and preservation of Indian performing arts over centuries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Natya-Shastra** is believed to have been written between 200 BCE and 200 CE.
 
• The text is divided into 36 chapters and contains around 6000 verses.
 
• It covers a wide range of topics, including the structure of a play, the types of drama, the principles of stage design, and the techniques of acting and dance.
 
• The Natya-Shastra also discusses the role of the audience and the impact of the performance on the viewers.
 
• Bharata Muni's work continues to be a vital source of knowledge for scholars, performers, and enthusiasts of Indian classical arts.

• These dances often serve as a means of storytelling, preserving history, and celebrating rituals.
 
 
 
• **Costumes and Instruments**:
 
 
• Tribal dance costumes are typically made from locally sourced materials, reflecting the community's heritage and environment.
 
• Instruments used in these dances vary, with drums, flutes, and string instruments being common.
 
 
 
• **Significance**:
 
 
• Tribal dances hold significant cultural importance, serving as a conduit for passing down traditions and values.
 
• They also play a role in social cohesion, bringing communities together in celebration and worship.

questions.question: Which of the following dance forms is inspired by the sculptures of the ancient temple of Chidambaram?
questions.solution:
The Correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharatanatyam** is one of the oldest classical dance forms of India.
 
• It is traditionally performed by **temple dancers** called **Devadasis**.
 
• Inspired by the sculptures of the ancient **Chidambaram temple** in Tamil Nadu, Bharatanatyam reflects the poses and postures seen in these sculptures.
 
• The dance form emphasizes **expressive hand gestures (Mudras), intricate footwork, and facial expressions**.
 
• **Nataraja**, the dancing pose of Lord Shiva, is a significant icon in Bharatanatyam.
 
• Bharatanatyam is known for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, and intricate rhythms.
 
• It is accompanied by classical Carnatic music, and performances often narrate stories from Hindu epics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kuchipudi**__

 __
 
• **Kuchipudi** originates from a village named **Kuchipudi** in Andhra Pradesh.
 
• It combines both **dancing and acting**, often performed as dance-dramas.
 
• Kuchipudi focuses on **graceful movements** and strong **narrative** elements.
 
 
 
• **Sattriya**__
 __
 
• **Sattriya** is a classical dance form from **Assam**.
 
• It was introduced by the Vaishnavite saint **Sankardev** in the 15th century.
 
• Traditionally performed in **Sattras** (monasteries), it has strong religious and cultural themes.
 
 
 
• **Manipuri**__
 
 
• **Manipuri** originates from the northeastern state of **Manipur**.
 
• It is known for its **graceful, fluid movements** and **expressive hand gestures**.
 
• Manipuri dance is deeply connected to the **Ras Leela** tradition associated with Lord Krishna.
